## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do as a learner (or a roadmap author), and what's
missing or awkward today?

## Proposed change

What you have in mind. Be as concrete as you can.

## Scope fit

The tutor works with any roadmap. How does this stay independent of one
particular roadmap or subject?

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.
